notes: THE COMMON-NAME TEST WAS APPLIED AND PASSED, so this row is deliberately NOT marked 'Ambiguous Match'. The brief required AIG AND cardiology to be matched explicitly before recording anything, because 'Prasada Reddy' is a common Telugu name with no distinctive surname. Both were matched explicitly: (a) AIG's own domain carries a live profile page for him, https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/dr-r-prasad-reddy , titled 'Dr. R Prasad Reddy - AIG Hospitals', which surfaced on a cardiology-specific query restricted to aighospitals.com; (b) HexaHealth lists him on its page of cardiologists AT AIG Hospital Gachibowli specifically, https://www.hexahealth.com/hyderabad/hospital/aig-hospital-gachibowli/doctors-list/cardiologist ; and (c) a JustDial listing title names him verbatim as 'Dr. Prasada Reddy R (Aig Hospitals) in Gachibowli, Hyderabad - Best Cardiologists', with the AIG Gachibowli street address in the URL. Name + specialty + hospital + branch + city all match. CRUCIALLY, THE SOURCES CONVERGE ON ONE PERSON RATHER THAN SEVERAL: every listing found - Practo, Credihealth, HexaHealth, Skedoc, DocIndia, myUpchar, ClinicSpots, Eka.care - gives the SAME three degree years, MBBS 1981, MD Paediatrics 1985, DM Cardiology 1989, and the same unusual paediatrics-to-cardiology career path.
